How to play
WASD↑←↓→WASD / Arrow keys: Move
Mouse: aim your torso and rifle
CLICKShoot (hold for full speed)

BATTLE POINTS: Hits, eliminations and holding the zone fill your BP meter to 100.
TRANSFORMATION: At 100 BP press E to become your hero for 12 seconds with double health.
ZONE A: Stand in the teal ring with no rival inside to hold it and score every 2 seconds.
HOW TO WIN: First side to the target score wins the match: 10 in Match 1, 15 in Match 2.
